'''Vandel''' was an independent prospector who along with his partner [[Helm]], were the first beings to discover the planet [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]], which was eventually named in their honor. Being the first to penetrate the vast cloud of asteroids that surrounded the planet circa [[3000 BBY]], they and found that the planet was incredibly rich in metals and ores. Claiming the world in the name of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] before relocating their families to the planet, they be came the founding members of the [[Metalsmiths Guild|Metalsmiths' Guild]]. Over the millennia, the Vandel and Helm families were regarded as royalty on Vandelhelm.
